; Alarm service + "island" notification for the openremarkable Alarm app.
;
; Adds an invisible layer on top of the whole UI (MainView, the root view inside
; main.qml's Window; patching main.qml itself has no effect on 3.25). It holds
; the alarm time; when it is reached it shows a small black pill at the top of
; the screen for 5 seconds (tap to dismiss early), over whatever is open.
; The Alarm app finds this layer by objectName "openremarkableAlarm" and calls
; setAlarm(epochMs) / cancelAlarm().
;
; Written against firmware 3.25.1.1. Applied by qt-resource-rebuilder (XOVI);
; install into /home/root/xovi/exthome/qt-resource-rebuilder/.
; Limits: the alarm lives in memory, so restarting the UI clears it, and while
; the tablet sleeps nothing runs: an alarm due during sleep shows on wake.

AFFECT /qml/device/view/main/MainView.qml
    TRAVERSE Background
        LOCATE AFTER ALL
        INSERT {
            Item {
                id: orAlarm
                objectName: "openremarkableAlarm"
                anchors.fill: parent
                z: 1000000

                property double alarmAt: 0          // epoch ms; 0 = no alarm
                readonly property bool armed: alarmAt > 0
                readonly property int showMs: 5000

                function pad(n) { return n < 10 ? "0" + n : "" + n; }
                function timeText(ms) {
                    const d = new Date(ms);
                    return pad(d.getHours()) + ":" + pad(d.getMinutes());
                }
                function setAlarm(ms) {
                    alarmAt = ms;
                    orAlarmCheck.restart();
                    console.log("[openremarkable-alarm] set for " + new Date(ms).toString());
                }
                function cancelAlarm() { alarmAt = 0; }
                Component.onCompleted: console.log("[openremarkable-alarm] layer ready; local time " + new Date().toString())
                function showIsland(text) {
                    orAlarmTime.text = text;
                    orAlarmIsland.visible = true;
                    orAlarmHide.restart();
                }

                // cheap wall-clock check; nothing is drawn until the alarm fires
                Timer {
                    id: orAlarmCheck
                    interval: 2000
                    repeat: true
                    running: orAlarm.armed
                    onTriggered: {
                        if (Date.now() >= orAlarm.alarmAt) {
                            const at = orAlarm.alarmAt;
                            orAlarm.alarmAt = 0;
                            orAlarm.showIsland(orAlarm.timeText(at));
                        }
                    }
                }
                Timer {
                    id: orAlarmHide
                    interval: orAlarm.showMs
                    onTriggered: orAlarmIsland.visible = false
                }

                Rectangle {
                    id: orAlarmIsland
                    objectName: "openremarkableAlarmIsland"
                    visible: false
                    anchors.horizontalCenter: parent.horizontalCenter
                    y: 24
                    height: 84
                    radius: height / 2
                    width: orAlarmRow.implicitWidth + 2 * 40
                    color: "black"

                    Row {
                        id: orAlarmRow
                        anchors.centerIn: parent
                        spacing: 18

                        // clock glyph, drawn so it never depends on icon assets
                        Item {
                            width: 44
                            height: 44
                            anchors.verticalCenter: parent.verticalCenter
                            Rectangle {
                                anchors.fill: parent
                                radius: width / 2
                                color: "transparent"
                                border.color: "white"
                                border.width: 4
                            }
                            Rectangle { x: 20; y: 9; width: 4; height: 15; radius: 2; color: "white" }
                            Rectangle { x: 20; y: 20; width: 12; height: 4; radius: 2; color: "white" }
                        }
                        Text {
                            text: "Alarm"
                            color: "white"
                            font.family: "reMarkable Sans"
                            font.pixelSize: 36
                            font.bold: true
                            anchors.verticalCenter: parent.verticalCenter
                        }
                        Text {
                            id: orAlarmTime
                            objectName: "openremarkableAlarmTime"
                            color: "white"
                            font.family: "reMarkable Sans"
                            font.pixelSize: 36
                            anchors.verticalCenter: parent.verticalCenter
                        }
                    }

                    MouseArea {
                        anchors.fill: parent
                        onClicked: orAlarmIsland.visible = false
                    }
                }
            }
        }
    END TRAVERSE
END AFFECT
